### Bio-Rad to Participate in Fireside Chat During Wells Fargo’s 21st Annual Healthcare Conference


August 31, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s29.q4cdn.com/260940227/files/doc_news/Bio-Rad-to-Participate-in-Fireside-Chat-During-Wells-Fargos-21st-Annual-Healthcare-Conference-2026.pdf)


HERCULES, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. (NYSE: BIO and BIO.B), a global leader in life science research and clinical diagnostics products, today announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Roop K. Lakkaraju, will participate in a fireside chat event during Wells Fargo’s 21st Annual Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, at 3:45 PM Eastern Time (12:45 PM Pacific Time).


A live[webcast](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FaMepMFxWv3z5SRZ9meKJzp%2F3jWGjFMjUgBB3EprgQcFJW&esheet=54596302&newsitemid=20260831154879&lan=en-US&anchor=webcast&index=1&md5=a30fe3bbfb706c9759cbfd10f8967919) and subsequent replay of the event will be available in the Investor Relations section of Bio-Rad’s website at[investors.bio-rad.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bio-rad.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54596302&newsitemid=20260831154879&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.bio-rad.com&index=2&md5=49dcf3b197036b716efdfe78292c6512) .


**About Bio-Rad**


Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. (NYSE: BIO and BIO.B) is a leader in developing, manufacturing, and marketing a broad range of products for the life science research and clinical diagnostics markets. Based in Hercules, California, Bio-Rad operates a global network of research, development, manufacturing, and sales operations with approximately 7,400 employees, and $2.6 billion in revenues in 2025. Our customers include universities, research institutions, hospitals, and biopharmaceutical companies, as well as clinical, food safety, and environmental quality laboratories. Together, we develop innovative, high-quality products that advance science and save lives. To learn more, visit[bio-rad.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bio-rad.com%2Fen-us%2Flife-science%2Fdroplet-digital-pcr&esheet=54596302&newsitemid=20260831154879&lan=en-US&anchor=bio-rad.com&index=3&md5=6e166f69d0e3a846cdfd97140b988950)
